other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Grid electricity emission factor derived from a power-generation mix that includes combined-cycle (and geothermal/solar/wind) plants, used to compute the CO2 emission factor — combined-cycle plants are continuous-flow power generation, but referenced only as background for the grid factor, not as the study's application context
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: In our particular case, combined cycle, geothermal, solar photovoltaic, and onshore wind power plants are considered.

one_line: Case study applying an ISO 50001 + ISO 46001 integrated energy- and water-management system to an unnamed (confidential) discrete manufacturing company in Mexico, tracking per-item energy, water, and CO2 reductions; production is item-based/discrete, not continuous-flow, and no registered Corpus B sector is the application context.
